summaries.name: California Department of Social Services
summaries.summary: California Department of Social Services (CDSS) licenses adoption agencies and social workers in California; adoption agencies must be licensed by CDSS to be considered credible for foster care adoption.

summaries.name: Council on Accreditation
summaries.summary: Council on Accreditation (COA) is a recognized accrediting body that can accredit California adoption agencies, alongside CDSS licensure, as a marker of credibility.

summaries.name: California Department of Justice
summaries.summary: California Department of Justice conducts child abuse clearance as part of the required criminal background checks during the home study process for foster care adoption in California.
